author: Travis Chinn
title: Spirit Lake school board approves moving forward on proposed facility improvements - NewsBreak
text:
By Travis Chinn ,
1 days ago
SPIRIT LAKE , Iowa ( KCAU ) — On Wednesday, the Spirit Lake School Board voted unanimously to move forward on possible facility improvements that will cost just under $70 million.
The vote was held at a special school board meeting at the Sammi Bedell Center in Spirit Lake.
Public input was heard on the project before the vote was taken.
Some of the infrastructure improvements include new classrooms and a new gymnasium in the elementary school, restroom upgrades and new gym bleachers in the middle school and some rebuilding and remodeling of the high school building.
The baseball and softball fields would also get new lights and the turf would be replaced at the football field.
Story continues below
"We don't have any choice on some of it. We just have old, outdated equipment that needs to be replaced. We have major infrastructure that needs to be replaced. If we don't, you could be on the verge of parts of your building not functioning and not being able to have school in the winter and then you have a bigger problem," said Spirit Lake Community Schools Superintendent Dr. David Smith.
Before the meeting, the school hosted tours of the buildings so folks could see the proposed changes.
The next step is for the board to gather a petition with 150 signatures and have another board meeting before August 26 to get the bond referendum on the November ballot so voters can decide on the project.
